commenti.body:
It's been a long time since I saw the film and I will not be watching it again. It's a great film that I would not suggest to anyone. 

But I think the scene you are talking about is a link to the previous film by Caspar Noe, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/I_Stand_Alone_(film)

I haven't seen the film in a long time, but there's a couple of suggestions that the chap in question (a teacher) has either form or a reputation for inappropriate relationships. Iirc later in the film he's talking about being sexually frustrated, saying something along the lines of "sometimes i just want to grab some kid and just..." before monica bellucci hushes him and tells him not to talk like that. Equally, it's likely that it's just some guy who's seen a dude commit a heinous murder in his favourite sex club hurling the worst abuse he can at the perpetrator. 

But a magnificent film that i have no plans to ever watch again.
